stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Job Agent v2.9.7 beta: when Jobs.cz presents a sensitive 'Pokračovat v odpovědi' preliminary-application handoff, Job Agent does not click it or claim a submission. It records PRE_APPLY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED and its local handoff URL, exposes an explicit 'Продолжить отклик вручную…' Dashboard action, reports pending manual follow-ups separately, and continues preparation of independent APPLY jobs. Login, consent and unconfirmed final-submit intervention statuses still pause the queue. Fixes metadata employer parsing where title fragments such as 'analytička' were incorrectly taken as a company. All 52 offline regression tests passed on GitHub Actions. Final submission remains manual.
